licenseRiders: ShareAlike: CC BY-SA 4.0 §3(b) makes any index derived from these files Adapted Material, which must itself be CC BY-SA 4.0 or a Compatible Licence. Keep UBS-derived fields in their own artefact — do not co-mingle them into a file that also carries fields from a BY-NC source, because BY-SA and BY-NC cannot both govern one adaptation.

Per-image copyright: the handbook licence covers the UBS *text*. Each plate carries its own Copyright string and, frequently, its own CC licence (CC0, CC BY 2.0, CC BY-SA 3.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, 'Public domain', 'Source unknown'). 380 distinct strings across 754 plates. Crediting only UBS would be false attribution.

The authoritative per-image detail is in `flora-fauna-realia/flora images-copyright.pdf` (102,566 b) and `fauna images-copyright.pdf` (103,862 b). There is NO equivalent PDF for REALIA, whose 392 plates are the largest group and are documented only by the in-XML Copyright element.
Image bytes are not licensed by these XML files and are not fetched. Shipping a plate requires clearing that plate's own Copyright string, not the handbook's.
8 plates carry an empty Copyright element and 6 more say only 'Source unknown' / '(Source unknown)'. These are not attributable and must not be displayed.

80 plates are machine-generated ('Image generated by ChatGPT using OpenAI technology', Collection OPEN-AI). Authorship and licence of model output are unsettled in several jurisdictions; treat them as neither UBS-authored nor public domain.

referenceFormat.bookNumbering: 1-based contiguous over the 66-book canon (MAT=40, no USFM gap), then deuterocanon 67+
referenceFormat.tail: doubled 1-based morpheme ordinal within the verse (ordinal = tail/2)
referenceFormat.tailIsNotAWordIndex: word-position=tail/2 scores 70.9% in-range / 11.6% Strong-exact over 257,361 SDBH Hebrew refs; morpheme-ordinal=tail/2 scores 99.4% / 56.3%, and 79.7% allowing +/-1
referenceFormat.tailIsNotACharacterOffset: 22,227 of 22,244 tails are even, and tail/2 stays within the verse's morpheme count 99.4% of the time; a character offset would exceed it almost always
referenceFormat.drift: exact agreement with OSHB segmentation is 91% at ordinals 1-4 and 23% at 40+, error almost always positive: MARBLE segments finer than OSHB and the excess accumulates. Cause not identified; the fused preposition+article hypothesis is refuted (45.5% < 56.3%).

sigils.none: FLORA and FAUNA omit it entirely (all 5,507 of their references)
sigils.L: Septuagint — all 1,704 land in deuterocanonical books
sigils.V: Vulgate Latin — all 108 land in book 82 (2 Esdras), the only book any Latin set cites

referenceFormat.sigilIsNotTheLanguageSetLanguage: 1,704 references sit in a Greek language set carrying L, 43 carry H, and 20 in a Hebrew set carrying A

resolution.versificationNote: Every versification-divergent reference is a Masoretic-vs-English numbering difference (Joel 4, Malachi 3:19-24, 1 Kings 5:20, Exodus 21:37, Numbers 17:23, Psalm superscriptions). The references are correct for the MT; our backbone is numbered the other way. Resolving them needs a versification map we do not have.

pathQuirk.verdict: One constant value for the whole corpus, naming FAUNA, with Windows separators, absent from all REALIA images. Key on FileName + Collection. Do not 'fix' the importer to use Path.

greek.note: 218 of the 231 unmatched Greek lemmas are cited only in deuterocanonical books, which MACULA (NT-only) cannot contain. Restricted to lemmas with at least one in-canon citation the match is 421/434 = 97.0%.

hebrew.bridge: oshb-wlc keys lemmas by Strong number, not pointed Hebrew, so the join is FFR lemma -> SDBH lemma -> StrongCodes -> oshb-wlc. Two hops.

imagePolicy.reason: 2.4 GB for 754 plate records whose metadata is 4.6 MB. Metadata imported; bytes deliberately left upstream.
imagePolicy.copyrightPdfsNeededForCompliance: Yes for FLORA and FAUNA if plates are ever displayed — the README says so in as many words ('See this information in the PDF files with copyright information'). Not needed to use the text/reference data imported here. REALIA has no such PDF, so its 392 plates rest on the in-XML Copyright element alone.
